# iosxe_voice_class_sip_event_list (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class SIP Event List configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_sip_event_list" "example" {
  tag = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class sip-event-list tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `events` (Set of String) Add event in the list of events to be passed thru
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
